disagreements.judge_why: The summary correctly applies the 15-day submission deadline from passage [1] to claim CLM-2026-00584 based on the discharge and receipt dates in the claim file.
The summary's position that the planned network admission is payable via pre-authorisation is supported by passage [1].
The summary's position and basis regarding room and boarding expenses for claim CLM-2026-00437 are supported by policy passages [1] and [4].

Claim CLM-2026-00483 states the position is PAYABLE and notes it is the second own damage claim, but passage [1] states a second claim results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil and does not support a payable coverage position for the claim itself under these facts.

verdicts.why: The compulsory deductible of INR 3,000 for vehicles above 1500cc stated in claim CLM-2026-00572 is fully supported by passage [2].
The summary's position that a 10% co-payment applies for the 67-year-old insured in claim CLM-2026-00578 is supported by passages [1], [2], and [4].
The summary correctly applies the 15-day submission deadline from passage [1] to claim CLM-2026-00584 based on the discharge and receipt dates in the claim file.
The summary's position that treatment outside India is not payable is supported by passages [1] and [2].

Claim CLM-2026-00561 states a position of PAYABLE for damage to tyres alone, but passage [1] specifies that Nil Depreciation does not extend to tyres, tubes, and batteries (and passage [8] notes the 50% tyre replacement limit) while the policy passages do not contain support for covering tyres damaged in isolation without other vehicle damage.
The summary for claim CLM-2026-00423 is supported by policy passage [1], which details the pro-rata refund for an annual policy when cancelled by the policyholder with no claims made.
The position that items such as hand wash, shoe covers, and attendant charges are not payable or are subsumed is supported by passages [1] and [4].
The summary's position that the planned network admission is payable via pre-authorisation is supported by passage [1].
The coverage position and basis for claim CLM-2026-00418 are supported by passage [1].
The summary's position and basis regarding room and boarding expenses for claim CLM-2026-00437 are supported by policy passages [1] and [4].

Claim CLM-2026-00483 states the position is PAYABLE and notes it is the second own damage claim, but passage [1] states a second claim results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil and does not support a payable coverage position for the claim itself under these facts.
Claim CLM-2026-00479 is supported by passage [1], which specifies the 30-day intimation requirement for newborn cover.
The summary for claim CLM-2026-00461 is supported by passages [1] and [5].
The summary's basis correctly cites passages [1] and [2] regarding road ambulance requirements and limits supported by the policy.
The basis of referral for investigation in claim CLM-2026-00472 is supported by passage [2].
Claim CLM-2026-00502 is supported by passages [1] confirming that cataract surgery requiring less than 24 hours of hospitalisation is a payable day care procedure.
The summary correctly notes that the provided context passages do not contain policy wordings covering exclusions for alcohol consumption [1], [2], [3], [4], [5].

The summary for CLM-2026-00491 correctly adopts a referred position and states that the context lacks the specific intimation deadline, which is supported by [4] and [5] since those passages do not state a motor claim intimation deadline.

The summary for claim CLM-2026-00496 states that the 12-month waiting period has been satisfied, but passage [4] only provides the duration of 12 months and does not support the calculation that the waiting period has been satisfied.
The summary's statements regarding the coverage provided for vehicle damage and the 45-day reimbursement submission window for claim CLM-2026-00521 are supported by policy passages [4] and [1].
The summary for claim CLM-2026-00526 is fully supported by passages [1] and [2].
The summary for claim CLM-2026-00533 is grounded because its statement that Endorsement END-2026-02 amends PW-HEALTH-002 and prevails in conflict is supported by passage [3].
The summary's position that arthrotomy of the hip joint performed with under 24 hours stay is payable is supported by passages [1], [2], [3], [4], and [5].
The summary's position that balloon sinuplasty is an eligible modern treatment covered up to the "In-Patient Hospitalization Treatment" Sum Insured is fully supported by passage [1].
The summary correctly identifies that baby charges, cradle charges, and other listed items are subsumed into room charges according to Section E, as supported by passage [1].
